📌 [...] Hi Product Hunt! I'm Jay, maker of Shadow and now Cakie. I just became a dad to twin girls. Best thing that's ever happened to me. But 16-hour days are over, so working efficiently matters more than ever. I use AI agents for most of my product work, and voice typing already made explaining ideas much faster. Something was still missing, though. A lot of what we communicate at work isn't text. It's the screen in front of us: the layout, the interaction, what happened after a click, the exact part we're looking at. With a teammate, I'd share my screen, point, and talk. I've been using Cake Equity for the past few months, and I've been very impressed with the platform. One of the things I like most about Cake Equity is how easy it is to use. The platform is intuitive, and I got up and running in just a few minutes. I also like the fact that Cake Equity is very customizable. I can easily add or remove features and even create custom reports. Another thing I like about Cake Equity is the customer support. The team is very responsive, and they're always willing to help me out. Their team has a very proactive onboarding support strategy and the support teams engage very early in the process. Review Cake Equity?

Reviewers describe Cake Equity as a simple, polished tool that removes much of the admin burden from cap table management, ESOPs, SAFEs, and convertible notes. They repeatedly praise how easy it is to set up, the clear view it gives founders, employees, and investors, and its usefulness for startups with global teams issuing equity across countries. Support is a recurring strength, with several users calling onboarding proactive and responses fast and helpful. The feedback is overwhelmingly positive, with no concrete drawbacks mentioned in the reviews provided.
